claims.evidence: Witness identifies only a generic transmission/torque converter assembly; no brand, model or OEM markings are legible in the photo.
Witness notes a small electrical connector/sensor wire but cannot confirm pin count.
No date, part number, or VIN-linked marking visible in the photo.
Subjective marketing language, not a verifiable physical attribute.
Import origin and history cannot be confirmed from a single static photo; no shipping/customs documents shown.
Witness explicitly lists 'whether tested and confirmed working' as not shown; no video or diagnostic readout provided.
No odometer, donor-vehicle photo, or mileage document visible.
Surface grime and oxidation are visible but do not confirm whether the casing has been opened; no seal/bolt-torque-mark close-up provided.

risks.risk: Internal gear/clutch/seal wear not visible from outside the casing.
risks.proof: Video of the transmission running on a test bench or installed in a vehicle, showing smooth shifting without grinding or slipping.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/unknown internal condition, i.e. worst case possible rebuild needed

risks.risk: Fluid leaks that only appear under pressure/operation.
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit running for several minutes showing no fluid seepage at seals or casing joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming a leak is present

risks.risk: Compatibility mismatch with buyer's specific Camry trim/engine (gearbox variants differ by engine code).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the part number/OEM tag or VIN plate from the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, buyer bears compatibility risk

risks.risk: 'Tested and working' claim unverified by independent evidence.
risks.proof: A timestamped video showing the gearbox being tested (e.g. on a rig) with audio of operation.

risks.risk: Mileage and history (accident, flood, prior rebuild) unknown.
risks.proof: Original import/customs documents or donor vehicle photos with odometer reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, treated as high-risk used unit

risks.risk: Electrical connector pin count and condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connector showing pin count and pin integrity.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming connector may not match buyer's harness

proof_requests: Video of the gearbox running/tested with audible operation and no leaks
Close-up photo of OEM part number/tag or VIN plate from donor vehicle
Close-up photo of the electrical connector showing pin count
Any import/customs documentation supporting 'Tokunbo direct from Belgium' claim
Photo of casing bolts/seals showing no prior disassembly
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a generic car transmission/torque converter assembly, so it can be priced, but all seller claims about brand, year, testing, mileage and origin are unverifiable or unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
